body.name: early-select, late-fit proximal ATT
body.construction: Select \(\widehat J_A\) by the ridge rule on \(\mathcal F_A\); discard \(\lceil(\log n)^2\rceil\) observations; solve the selected bridge moment on \(\mathcal B_n\); average the selected fitted residual on \(\mathcal C_n\); and studentize using separate Bartlett HAC estimates on \(\mathcal B_n\) and \(\mathcal C_n\) with bandwidth \(h_n\).
